methods.name: __updateLoadState

methods.name: _loadResources

methods.name: _unloadResources

methods.name: getLoadedPromise
methods.documentation: 先跨过一帧；forceLoaded=false 时 unloaded 也满足，不能据此断言 GPU 资源已建立。

classes.name: CMTSComponent
classes.documentation: 地面查询把椭球 LLA 方向转六面 UV，沿当前可见叶块采样高度；相机位置转实体局部系参与 LOD。端点配置和瓦片过渡分别跟踪完成状态。

classes.name: CMTSTile
classes.documentation: 每边网格含一圈裙边；内部索引跨度为 verticesPerSide−3。纹理有两像素边框（宽度 +4），UV 可来自祖先纹理；mesh 坐标减中心以保持浮点精度。

methods.name: constructor
throws: new Error(`No spheroid component on the ${component}!`)

methods.name: getHeight
methods.documentation: 高度取当前正式或临时 mesh 的插值位置再反解 LLA；不是重复读取已释放的高度 ImageData。

methods.name: checkJoin
methods.documentation: 合并距离阈值是分裂阈值的四倍，保留 LOD 滞回，避免临界距离逐帧抖动。

methods.name: _createTempObject
methods.documentation: 向祖先回溯到已完成 mesh，同时累积子象限 UV；低分辨率占位网格从祖先 mesh 插值，临时纹理仍独立 acquire。

methods.name: _createObject
methods.documentation: 批量资源返回后先检查销毁并逐项 release；正式顶点以定时批次生成，结束后才发布 GPU 数组并释放临时 mesh 与高度图。

methods.name: _destroyObject
methods.documentation: 非 height 贴图逐项 release，再销毁 material/mesh 并从 component 数组移除；height ImageData 在独立生命周期释放。

methods.name: _getFromData
methods.documentation: 按连续列/行坐标双线性混合三分量数组，先沿行再沿列；边界与额外裙边由调用者保证可访问。

methods.name: _updateVertex
methods.documentation: 位置先在有效内区采样，高度法线用跨边界邻点差分；裙边另作径向下沉。tangent/bitangent 与贴图 UV 保留原面方向和 y 翻转。

methods.name: _loadTexture
methods.documentation: await 之后再次检查 tile 是否销毁：已销毁则 release，存活才安装，防止晚到资源取得新所有权。

methods.name: _isInABoundary
methods.documentation: 将配置最深级边界按 2^(last_level−level) 整数投影到当前层，行列上下界均包含端点。

methods.name: getLinearInterpolatedHeightPixel
methods.documentation: 像素中心在半整数，按距离中心选相邻像素权重；边缘像素索引由 getHeightFromPixel 截断。RGB 分别贡献 2^−8、2^−16、2^−24。

methods.name: cmtsCoordToPosition
methods.documentation: 先把 tile 坐标乘 2^−level 得面 UV；越界时逐步跨六面旋转/翻转坐标，直到落入 [0,1]，再由固定面基投影椭球。

files.purpose: 管理透视投影、拾取、遮挡检测、多段深度渲染及后处理的渲染相机组件。

methods.name: constructor
methods.documentation: PerspectiveCamera 只作为 Three 相机载体，后续以 +Y 前向自定义矩阵覆盖默认投影。后处理顺序为 RenderPass → OutlinePass → UnrealBloomPass，后两项默认禁用。

methods.name: getHorizontalFieldOfView
methods.documentation: _fieldOfView 是较长屏幕轴的角度，单位为弧度；横屏直接作为水平角，竖屏按宽高比缩小水平角。

methods.name: getVerticalFieldOfView
methods.documentation: 横屏按宽高比缩小垂直角，竖屏直接使用 _fieldOfView。不要把它当 Three.PerspectiveCamera 的固定垂直 degree fov。

methods.name: getNormalSpacePositionFromCameraSpacePosition
methods.documentation: 输入只去掉相机平移、仍沿世界轴；先乘实体朝向的逆得到 +Y 前向坐标，再按投影矩阵的列主序 elements[0/9/6/14] 求 NDC。

methods.name: getCameraSpacePositionFromNormalSpacePosition
methods.documentation: 与正向公式共用同一深度系数，恢复 +Y 前向坐标后再乘相机实体朝向。池向量在 copy 完成后归还，允许 output 与输入别名。

methods.name: getRaycast
methods.documentation: 先让目标实体把本相机的显示状态/矩阵写到 Three 对象；Three.Raycaster 返回的是相机平移原点下的坐标，再还原为命中实体局部帧。只去重同对象、同面顶点索引的连续命中。

methods.name: setOutline

methods.name: __render
methods.documentation: 渲染相机只设置朝向；实体对象已经相对相机平移，不应再给 Three 相机写同一大尺度世界位置。Composer 运行 Render/Outline/Bloom 通道。

files.purpose: 依据主/次轴和目标的点向、速度或轴向约束计算实体姿态，并登记目标状态依赖。

methods.name: addModifiedState

files.purpose: 读取 Dynamo v1/v2 定义与分层时间块，按五类样本插值驱动实体运动和姿态。

classes.name: Point
classes.documentation: 样本时间来自文件的 Float64；calculate 的输出对象由控制器复用，不改写端点样本。

classes.name: PosPoint
classes.documentation: 三次 Hermite 插值同时使用两端位置和速度；速度为同一多项式对时间的导数，比例不截断，因此允许外推。

methods.name: load

methods.documentation: 记录为 time、position.xyz，共四个 Float64（32 字节）；文件不携带速度。

classes.name: OriPoint
classes.documentation: 先按各端点角速度传播到查询时间，再球面混合姿态；临时四元数和向量均归还对象池。

methods.name: load
methods.documentation: 记录为 time、四元数四分量、angularVelocity.xyz，共八个 Float64（64 字节）；四元数顺序沿构造器约定。

methods.name: _project
methods.documentation: 角速度模长乘时间差得到轴角（弧度）；增量模式依赖调用者给定的输出初态，临时旋转从对象池借还。

classes.name: QuatPoint
classes.documentation: 仅对姿态样本做截断球面混合；应用到实体时角速度固定为零。

methods.name: load

classes.name: CameraViewBlock
classes.documentation: 相机选项工厂保存目标 id 与各自选择/取消回调，切换时先取消旧选项再启用新选项。航天器选项等待实体就绪并核对当前视图目标，避免旧目标的异步结果覆盖新路由。renderFlag 是原有未使用的兼容参数，不推断其未证实含义。

files.purpose: 轮播条目选择、滚动与响应式显示

classes.name: Carousel
classes.documentation: 幻灯片节点与进入/离开回调按索引归轮播持有；切换先 await 旧页退出，再更新轨道和新页显示，最后 await 新页进入。滚动边界与触摸方向共同决定翻页，timeout 防止连续手势重复切换。

files.purpose: 轮播面板及其条目生命周期

classes.name: CarouselPanel
classes.documentation: Swiper 全局索引与标签页局部索引分开维护；分页圆点仅覆盖当前标签范围。每张长内容页持有滚动实例和拖动状态，mouseup 闭包成对撤销窗口鼠标监听。

files.purpose: 复选输入状态与 change 回调

classes.name: Checkbox
classes.documentation: 勾选状态与三个模板 class 同步更新；skipCallback 用于程序化同步显示而不重复执行外部业务动作。

files.purpose: 故事内容中的复选项组

classes.name: CheckboxBlock
classes.documentation: 故事提供 checkboxContent 和 onChange；此块只拥有生成的 label/input 节点，变更事件连同应用实例转交配置回调。

files.purpose: 扩展复选框以表示多个状态

classes.name: CheckboxMultistate
classes.documentation: 多态复选框替换父类的二态点击监听；状态索引循环，显式 requestedStateIndex 优先，class 表与回调收到同一新索引。

methods.name: setNumStates
literals: Number of states must be at least 2

files.purpose: 时间编辑、显示、时区和边界提示

classes.name: Clock
classes.documentation: 时钟格式由 time 管理器统一持有，普通时钟订阅 update，kiosk 计时器由调用者直接传文本。编辑提交经解析后写入路由；停用时取消限时提示的隐藏计时器。

files.purpose: 快速日期时间选择入口

classes.name: ClockShortcut
classes.documentation: 时间管理器 update 订阅通过基类注册表随启停解除。外部视图可接管返回实时操作，未接管时才修改路由时间与速率。

files.purpose: 可折叠工具菜单和子项显示

classes.name: CollapsibleMenu
classes.documentation: 菜单保存项目顺序与已展开队列，依据各项最大高度计算剩余空间；新增项目可复用现存组件，组件订阅则登记在本菜单的回调注册表。

files.purpose: 工具菜单中的独立动作项

classes.name: CollapsibleMenuItem
classes.documentation: 子组件 DOM 移入本项容器，同时记录 _cMenuParent 供视图访问；展开事件先发出，再更新本项状态、子组件可见性和尺寸。

files.purpose: 目标与比较对象的尺寸、距离或照片比较交互

classes.name: Comparison
classes.documentation: 两侧对象说明异步读取后转换成单份模板状态；航天器等按长度显示，天体右侧按半径比显示。小单位切换发生在数值格式化前，保持 NASA 原比较规则。

files.purpose: 按路由描述装配对象内容块并控制面板折叠与覆盖

classes.name: ContentPanel
classes.documentation: 面板拥有对象/事件/特征内容块与 tab 拓扑，路由刷新先停用旧块并克隆默认拓扑，再按资源能力增删块。加载完成后的对象阶段单独补入相机与贴图选项，多处取消检查还核对当前目标。移动布局把 overview 和 replay 作为持久块处理，拖动结束吸附到计算出的高度档位；桌面改用展开/折叠状态。routeFlag、refreshFlag 为原有未读取参数，保留签名但不推断业务用途。

files.purpose: DescriptionBlock-1005 模块

classes.name: DescriptionBlock
classes.documentation: 描述文本中的月球计数来自实体分组，必要时退回父实体；移动布局直接显示更多内容，桌面展开时保留原滚动位置规则。

files.purpose: DescriptionBlock-541 模块

classes.name: DescriptionBlock
classes.documentation: 故事描述的更多内容由 info.more 决定；_more 保存完整按钮文字、图标和 class 快照，切换时与 isMoreVisible 一并提交。

files.purpose: 距离源目标选择和距离计算显示面板

classes.name: DistancePanel
classes.documentation: 测距计算归 distance 管理器，面板持有拖动坐标、移动布局与线条交互状态。按下时登记窗口移动/抬起监听，抬起保存限位坐标并解除监听；屏幕中心改变时补偿面板位置。线条点击吸附到源、中心或目标，再由管理器转换到三维线偏移。原 removeAllEvents 的 hover 监听添加行为保留，未在去混淆中修复。

methods.name: setResult
literals: info semi small color gray med

files.purpose: 对象事件列表内容块

classes.name: EventsBlock
classes.documentation: 此块在表格与共享 eventsTimeline 间切换；共享时间线重新挂到本块容器。实体就绪后才提交事件集合和选择，排序会替换本块的事件数组但不修改目录事件对象。

methods.name: constructor
literals: Select an event below to learn more.
Click or tap an event to start the animation

files.purpose: 航天器事件时间轴、播放和当前事件选择

classes.name: EventsTimeline
classes.documentation: 时间线分为总览标记与放大 focusPanel 两个坐标空间，各自保存 hover/touch/双击和时间指示线状态。事件按像素间隔与容量聚类，焦点区另做碰撞让位；时间与像素换算必须保留各自 padding 和范围。动画先退出旧簇、重建焦点节点再进入新簇，onfinish 解除 animating 门闩；鼠标和触摸的方向、阈值与延迟提示独立。_setEvents 只复制数组，仍会把传入事件对象的起止值改为 Moment，保留这项原有所有权行为。

files.purpose: 对象探索入口内容块

classes.name: ExplorationBlock
classes.documentation: 初始列表和更多列表分别创建节点，更多项带状态占位符；创建完后重新扫描变量绑定，使继承的更多开关能控制这些新节点。

files.purpose: 精选事件卡片内容块

classes.name: FeaturedEventsBlock
classes.documentation: 精选事件引用与事件详情分离：首屏从传入 eventsById 取详情，更多列表按原实现读取全局事件表；每项闭包保留独立事件路径。

files.purpose: 精选卫星内容块

classes.name: FeaturedMoonsBlock
classes.documentation: 路由取消令牌同时守住整次刷新和逐项 DOM 构建；更多项重新登记模板 class 绑定，以便继承的展开逻辑控制可见性。

files.purpose: 首页精选故事卡片面板

classes.name: FeaturedStoriesPanel
classes.documentation: 面板拥有 featuredStoryBlock 和滚动条；路由取消后不启用故事块。显隐同时通知当前视图调整视口，并同步移动展开按钮与可访问标签。

files.purpose: 单个精选故事卡片

classes.name: FeaturedStoryBlock
classes.documentation: 故事卡片支持外部链接、内部路由和故事 id 三种跳转。节点由此块重建，标题和颜色等 class 占位符在创建后登记到基类状态绑定。

files.purpose: 对象特征选项列表

classes.name: FeaturesBlock
classes.documentation: 特征定义上挂接的点击函数直接切换引擎 Features 状态；UI 复选框读取同一引擎状态，目标无可用特征时沿父实体查找。

files.purpose: 故事提示内容

classes.name: HintBlock
classes.documentation: 提示正文与前后图标来自故事 info；构造时写入模板状态，滚动叙事行为继续由 StoryBaseContentBlock 管理。

files.purpose: 故事图像与说明内容

classes.name: ImageBlock
classes.documentation: 点击时复制当前图片节点交给共享 overlay；保留原图片在故事布局中的位置，覆盖层拥有副本的挂载位置。

files.purpose: 辅助对象信息面板

classes.name: InfoPanel
classes.documentation: 面板把自身根节点交给共享 overlay 挂载，show/hide 同时协调覆盖层；重复 hide 仅在原面板可见时执行。

files.purpose: 仪器视场选项内容块

classes.name: InstrumentFOVBlock
classes.documentation: 仪器配置与实例几何分离，实例属性优先于仪器公共属性。存在 keyframes 的仪器使用三态开关：关闭、覆盖区间、完整视锥；总开关与单仪器互相同步时跳过回调，避免循环触发。

files.purpose: 展陈模式基础界面及计时行为

classes.name: KioskBase
classes.documentation: 会话与空闲分别使用独立 interval，交互时清理并重新启动空闲计时；重置应用等待相机转换再归还实时模式。组件显隐与启用配置分开保存，避免混淆暂时隐藏和停止订阅。

files.purpose: 图层分组与可见性开关面板

classes.name: LayerPanel
classes.documentation: 两种复选框实现共享 layer 管理器事件：NASA eyes 原生 input 与组件 Checkbox。事件回流只同步 UI 状态，程序化 toggle 传 skipCallback 避免再次发出图层切换。

files.purpose: 对象相关图层选项内容块

classes.name: LayersBlock
classes.documentation: 上下文图层工厂闭包保存父实体与卫星组；majorMoons 文本计算也更新 minorMoons 数量。主 spacecraft 图层事件同步 orbiters/landers 等子项，重置时沿用查询与默认可见性优先级。

files.purpose: 加载指示器显示与隐藏

classes.name: LoadIcon
classes.documentation: 场景 loading/loaded 事件直接映射为显示和隐藏，订阅登记交给 BaseComponent 随组件启停管理。

files.purpose: 主菜单、搜索和导航入口

classes.name: Menu
classes.documentation: 菜单缓存分类列表和按首字母分组的 DOM，移动布局把分类列表从主菜单移出再单独挂载。每次切换菜单销毁旧滚动条，跳转条目按外部链接、内部链接、故事与实体分别处理。

files.purpose: 移动端展开目标内容面板的按钮

classes.name: MobileExpandButton
classes.documentation: 按钮保存当前内容组件名，点击后调用该组件的展开接口并隐藏自身；桌面环境会强制抑制移动展开按钮。

files.purpose: 遮罩显示和关闭交互

classes.name: Overlay
classes.documentation: 覆盖层持有当前内容节点，替换内容时更新同一状态引用；动画结束后才将隐藏覆盖层 display 置为 none，重新显示前恢复 display。

files.purpose: 对象概览内容块

classes.name: OverviewBlock
classes.documentation: 概览将实体/事件信息与描述日期合并成模板状态；通用模型免责声明取引擎当前模型 URL，返回按钮监听在实体就绪后挂接。

methods.name: onRouteChange
literals: is represented by a generic model.

files.purpose: 相关对象链接内容块

classes.name: RelatedBlock
classes.documentation: 相关对象列表按目录分类生成形状；故事卡片可跳外部、内部或故事路由。内部链接等待场景与相机完成后才选择内容标签页。

files.purpose: 对象事件重播控件

classes.name: ReplayBlock
classes.documentation: 事件时间滑块持有起止 Date，时间 update 订阅反向同步进度；拖动结束恢复播放，接近终点暂停并切换重播图标。时钟组件重新挂到本块容器。

files.purpose: 故事内重播按钮

classes.name: ReplayButtonBlock
classes.documentation: fromStart 决定重新导航到故事入口还是重载当前路由，按钮文字也沿用同一故事配置，避免两种重播语义混淆。

files.purpose: 搜索输入、建议结果和选择导航

classes.name: Search
classes.documentation: 输入防抖后由 search 管理器返回匹配，低分结果和建议分开渲染；结果数组同时保存链接与 DOM，供键盘与悬停共享选择索引。单结果详情失败为 404 时回退列表，相关故事/事件等块继续加入同一导航序列。

files.purpose: 单位、图层等用户设置的交互界面

classes.name: Settings
classes.documentation: 能力配置与按钮状态分离：视图可临时替换 zoom 回调和显示能力，方向规则按设备顺序匹配。长按缩放先等待阈值再开启 interval，松开重置持续缩放标记；光照同时同步常规相机与比较管理器。

files.purpose: 分享 URL、嵌入设置和复制界面

classes.name: ShareModal
classes.documentation: 分享源 URL 先过滤非保留查询，嵌入选项再按默认值与依赖条件生成最终参数。预览强制 tracking=false，iframe hash 变化只更新代码而不重建预览；更换预览 iframe 前解除旧 load 监听。表单 DOM 与帮助提示归此组件持有。

files.purpose: 对象特殊功能入口

classes.name: SpecialFeaturesBlock
classes.documentation: 可用工具列表由实体能力生成，已着陆对象隐藏此块；各条目拥有独立查询和导航选项，距离工具保留时间。

files.purpose: 对象表面地图选择

classes.name: SurfaceMapBlock
classes.documentation: 表面地图选项向 layer 管理器提交地图描述，并发出 surfaceMapEnabled 供 HD 开关同步。默认地图另保留原贴图信息；火星默认项恢复 CMTS，其余对象切回默认纹理。

files.purpose: 望远镜观察目标、视场和相机控制

classes.name: Telescope
classes.documentation: 进入望远镜模式临时接管对象点击、光照与表面地图，退出归还原状态并清理拾取控制器和方位角计时器。拾取位置先逆旋转到目标局部坐标，再换算经纬度写入标记与路由。

methods.name: onEnter
literals: Positive inputs are North and East. Negative inputs are South and West.

methods.name: exitTelescope
literals: Space object could not be located in the url

files.purpose: 对象纹理质量选择

classes.name: TextureQualityBlock
classes.documentation: HD 开关依赖 scene 管理器的实际纹理状态，并受 surfaceMapEnabled 事件协调；URL 配置只在对应选项存在时应用。目标切换会重置旧选项上下文。

files.purpose: 时间播放速率与时间拖动控制

classes.name: TimeControls
classes.documentation: 滑块位置通过双向分段速率表转换，反向速率限制为不高于 -1；旋钮图形只是速率的视觉投影。路由写入节流与绘图节流独立，停用清理触摸提示计时器。

files.purpose: 故事标题内容块

classes.name: TitleBlock
classes.documentation: 此类只选择故事标题模板；状态、点击与进入退出行为完全继承 StoryBaseContentBlock，没有独立事件或资源所有权。

files.purpose: 临时通知消息及定时隐藏

classes.name: Toast
classes.documentation: 自动隐藏计时器归本组件持有，重复显示先取消旧计时器，手动隐藏也取消计时器并清除错误样式。

files.purpose: 故事内开关交互

classes.name: ToggleBlock
classes.documentation: 进入时将选中状态同步到故事配置，退出时撤销选中；onClick 先执行父类动作，再更新模板选择状态，保持故事动作顺序。

files.purpose: 对象工具入口集合

classes.name: ToolboxBlock
classes.documentation: 导航参数数组由此块保存并交给 router 展开调用；桌面提示交给 tippy，触摸端另用 DOM 弹层及外部点击关闭逻辑。

files.purpose: 教程步骤遮罩与提示定位

classes.name: TutorialOverlay
classes.documentation: 教程实例持有 Swiper、目标测量缓存及延迟初始化/已读计时器。路由只在主页且未取消时驱动教程，mask 百分比由目标视口比例换算，已读索引写入 localStorage。

classes.name: Vector2
classes.documentation:
Class representing a 2D vector. A 2D vector is an ordered pair of numbers
(labeled x and y), which can be used to represent a number of things, such as:

- A point in 2D space (i.e. a position on a plane).
- A direction and length across a plane. In three.js the length will
always be the Euclidean distance(straight-line distance) from `(0, 0)` to `(x, y)`
and the direction is also measured from `(0, 0)` towards `(x, y)`.
- Any arbitrary ordered pair of numbers.

There are other things a 2D vector can be used to represent, such as
momentum vectors, complex numbers and so on, however these are the most
common uses in three.js.

Iterating through a vector instance will yield its components `(x, y)` in
the corresponding order.
```js
const a = new THREE.Vector2( 0, 1 );

//no arguments; will be initialised to (0, 0)
const b = new THREE.Vector2( );

const d = a.distanceTo( b );
```

classes.name: Vector3
classes.documentation:
Class representing a 3D vector. A 3D vector is an ordered triplet of numbers
(labeled x, y and z), which can be used to represent a number of things, such as:

- A point in 3D space.
- A direction and length in 3D space. In three.js the length will
always be the Euclidean distance(straight-line distance) from `(0, 0, 0)` to `(x, y, z)`
and the direction is also measured from `(0, 0, 0)` towards `(x, y, z)`.
- Any arbitrary ordered triplet of numbers.

There are other things a 3D vector can be used to represent, such as

classes.name: Matrix3
classes.documentation:
Represents a 3x3 matrix.

A Note on Row-Major and Column-Major Ordering:

The constructor and {@link Matrix3#set} method take arguments in
[row-major](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Row-_and_column-major_order#Column-major_order)
order, while internally they are stored in the {@link Matrix3#elements} array in column-major order.
This means that calling:
```js
const m = new THREE.Matrix();
m.set( 11, 12, 13,
       21, 22, 23,
       31, 32, 33 );
```
will result in the elements array containing:
```js
m.elements = [ 11, 21, 31,
               12, 22, 32,
               13, 23, 33 ];
```
and internally all calculations are performed using column-major ordering.
However, as the actual ordering makes no difference mathematically and
most people are used to thinking about matrices in row-major order, the
three.js documentation shows matrices in row-major order. Just bear in
mind that if you are reading the source code, you'll have to take the
transpose of any matrices outlined here to make sense of the calculations.

classes.name: Vector4
classes.documentation:
Class representing a 4D vector. A 4D vector is an ordered quadruplet of numbers
(labeled x, y, z and w), which can be used to represent a number of things, such as:

- A point in 4D space.
- A direction and length in 4D space. In three.js the length will
always be the Euclidean distance(straight-line distance) from `(0, 0, 0, 0)` to `(x, y, z, w)`
and the direction is also measured from `(0, 0, 0, 0)` towards `(x, y, z, w)`.
- Any arbitrary ordered quadruplet of numbers.

There are other things a 4D vector can be used to represent, however these
are the most common uses in *three.js*.

Iterating through a vector instance will yield its components `(x, y, z, w)` in
the corresponding order.
```js
const a = new THREE.Vector4( 0, 1, 0, 0 );

//no arguments; will be initialised to (0, 0, 0, 1)
const b = new THREE.Vector4( );

const d = a.dot( b );
```

classes.name: Matrix4
classes.documentation:
Represents a 4x4 matrix.

The most common use of a 4x4 matrix in 3D computer graphics is as a transformation matrix.
For an introduction to transformation matrices as used in WebGL, check out [this tutorial](https://www.opengl-tutorial.org/beginners-tutorials/tutorial-3-matrices)

This allows a 3D vector representing a point in 3D space to undergo
transformations such as translation, rotation, shear, scale, reflection,
orthogonal or perspective projection and so on, by being multiplied by the
matrix. This is known as `applying` the matrix to the vector.

A Note on Row-Major and Column-Major Ordering:

The constructor and {@link Matrix3#set} method take arguments in
[row-major](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Row-_and_column-major_order#Column-major_order)
order, while internally they are stored in the {@link Matrix3#elements} array in column-major order.
This means that calling:
```js
const m = new THREE.Matrix4();
m.set( 11, 12, 13, 14,
       21, 22, 23, 24,
       31, 32, 33, 34,
       41, 42, 43, 44 );
```
will result in the elements array containing:
```js
m.elements = [ 11, 21, 31, 41,
               12, 22, 32, 42,
               13, 23, 33, 43,
               14, 24, 34, 44 ];
```
and internally all calculations are performed using column-major ordering.
However, as the actual ordering makes no difference mathematically and
most people are used to thinking about matrices in row-major order, the
three.js documentation shows matrices in row-major order. Just bear in
mind that if you are reading the source code, you'll have to take the
transpose of any matrices outlined here to make sense of the calculations.

classes.name: MeshPhysicalMaterial
classes.documentation:
An extension of the {@link MeshStandardMaterial}, providing more advanced
physically-based rendering properties:

- Anisotropy: Ability to represent the anisotropic property of materials
as observable with brushed metals.
- Clearcoat: Some materials — like car paints, carbon fiber, and wet surfaces — require
a clear, reflective layer on top of another layer that may be irregular or rough.
Clearcoat approximates this effect, without the need for a separate transparent surface.
- Iridescence: Allows to render the effect where hue varies  depending on the viewing
angle and illumination angle. This can be seen on soap bubbles, oil films, or on the
wings of many insects.
- Physically-based transparency: One limitation of {@link Material#opacity} is that highly
transparent materials are less reflective. Physically-based transmission provides a more
realistic option for thin, transparent surfaces like glass.
- Advanced reflectivity: More flexible reflectivity for non-metallic materials.
- Sheen: Can be used for representing cloth and fabric materials.

As a result of these complex shading features, `MeshPhysicalMaterial` has a
higher performance cost, per pixel, than other three.js materials. Most
effects are disabled by default, and add cost as they are enabled. For
best results, always specify an environment map when using this material.

@augments MeshStandardMaterial
@demo scenes/material-browser.html#MeshPhysicalMaterial

methods.name: constructor
methods.documentation: 基于 Standard，增加 STANDARD+PHYSICAL，ior=1.5、reflectivity getter=clamp(2.5*(ior-1)/(ior+1),0,1)，setter 反算 ior。薄膜 IOR=1.3、厚度范围[100,400]，clearcoatNormalScale=(1,1)、sheenColor黑、attenuationColor/specularColor白、attenuationDistance=Infinity；内部 anisotropy/clearcoat/dispersion/iridescence/sheen/transmission 初值0，maps 为null，最后 setValues。反射率不是独立存储字段。

classes.name: MeshPhongMaterial
classes.documentation:
A material for shiny surfaces with specular highlights.

The material uses a non-physically based [Blinn-Phong](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Blinn-Phong_shading_model)
model for calculating reflectance. Unlike the Lambertian model used in the
{@link MeshLambertMaterial} this can simulate shiny surfaces with specular
highlights (such as varnished wood). `MeshPhongMaterial` uses per-fragment shading.

Performance will generally be greater when using this material over the
{@link MeshStandardMaterial} or {@link MeshPhysicalMaterial}, at the cost of
some graphical accuracy.

@augments Material
@demo scenes/material-browser.html#MeshPhongMaterial

classes.documentation:
A material for non-shiny surfaces, without specular highlights.

The material uses a non-physically based [Lambertian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lambertian_reflectance)
model for calculating reflectance. This can simulate some surfaces (such
as untreated wood or stone) well, but cannot simulate shiny surfaces with
specular highlights (such as varnished wood). `MeshLambertMaterial` uses per-fragment
shading.

Due to the simplicity of the reflectance and illumination models,
performance will be greater when using this material over the
{@link MeshPhongMaterial}, {@link MeshStandardMaterial} or
{@link MeshPhysicalMaterial}, at the cost of some graphical accuracy.

@augments Material
@demo scenes/material-browser.html#MeshLambertMaterial

classes.name: Interpolant
classes.documentation:
Abstract base class of interpolants over parametric samples.

The parameter domain is one dimensional, typically the time or a path
along a curve defined by the data.

The sample values can have any dimensionality and derived classes may
apply special interpretations to the data.

This class provides the interval seek in a Template Method, deferring
the actual interpolation to derived classes.

Time complexity is O(1) for linear access crossing at most two points
and O(log N) for random access, where N is the number of positions.

References: {@link http://www.oodesign.com/template-method-pattern.html}

@abstract

DirectionalLight
classes.documentation:
A light that gets emitted in a specific direction. This light will behave
as though it is infinitely far away and the rays produced from it are all
parallel. The common use case for this is to simulate daylight; the sun is
far enough away that its position can be considered to be infinite, and
all light rays coming from it are parallel.

A common point of confusion for directional lights is that setting the
rotation has no effect. This is because three.js's DirectionalLight is the
equivalent to what is often called a 'Target Direct Light' in other
applications.

This means that its direction is calculated as pointing from the light's
{@link Object3D#position} to the {@link DirectionalLight#target} position
(as opposed to a 'Free Direct Light' that just has a rotation
component).

This light can cast shadows - see the {@link DirectionalLightShadow} for details.

```js
// White directional light at half intensity shining from the top.
const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight( 0xffffff, 0.5 );
scene.add( directionalLight );
```

@augments Light

classes.name: RectAreaLight
classes.documentation:
This class emits light uniformly across the face a rectangular plane.
This light type can be used to simulate light sources such as bright
windows or strip lighting.

Important Notes:

- There is no shadow support.
- Only PBR materials are supported.
- You have to include `RectAreaLightUniformsLib` (`WebGLRenderer`) or `RectAreaLightTexturesLib` (`WebGPURenderer`)
into your app and init the uniforms/textures.

```js
RectAreaLightUniformsLib.init(); // only relevant for WebGLRenderer
THREE.RectAreaLightNode.setLTC( RectAreaLightTexturesLib.init() ); //  only relevant for WebGPURenderer

const intensity = 1; const width = 10; const height = 10;
const rectLight = new THREE.RectAreaLight( 0xffffff, intensity, width, height );
rectLight.position.set( 5, 5, 0 );
rectLight.lookAt( 0, 0, 0 );
scene.add( rectLight )
```

@augments Light

classes.name: LightProbe
classes.documentation:
Light probes are an alternative way of adding light to a 3D scene. Unlike
classical light sources (e.g. directional, point or spot lights), light
probes do not emit light. Instead they store information about light
passing through 3D space. During rendering, the light that hits a 3D
object is approximated by using the data from the light probe.

Light probes are usually created from (radiance) environment maps. The
class {@link LightProbeGenerator} can be used to create light probes from
cube textures or render targets. However, light estimation data could also
be provided in other forms e.g. by WebXR. This enables the rendering of
augmented reality content that reacts to real world lighting.

The current probe implementation in three.js supports so-called diffuse
light probes. This type of light probe is functionally equivalent to an
irradiance environment map.

@augments Light

classes.documentation:
This class is an alternative to {@link Clock} with a different API design and behavior.
The goal is to avoid the conceptual flaws that became apparent in `Clock` over time.

- `Timer` has an `update()` method that updates its internal state. That makes it possible to
call `getDelta()` and `getElapsed()` multiple times per simulation step without getting different values.
- The class can make use of the Page Visibility API to avoid large time delta values when the app
is inactive (e.g. tab switched or browser hidden).

```js
const timer = new Timer();
timer.connect( document ); // use Page Visibility API
```

classes.name: Matrix2
classes.documentation:
Represents a 2x2 matrix.

A Note on Row-Major and Column-Major Ordering:

The constructor and {@link Matrix2#set} method take arguments in
[row-major](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Row-_and_column-major_order#Column-major_order)
order, while internally they are stored in the {@link Matrix2#elements} array in column-major order.
This means that calling:
```js
const m = new THREE.Matrix2();
m.set( 11, 12,
       21, 22 );
```
will result in the elements array containing:
```js
m.elements = [ 11, 21,
               12, 22 ];
```
and internally all calculations are performed using column-major ordering.
However, as the actual ordering makes no difference mathematically and
most people are used to thinking about matrices in row-major order, the
three.js documentation shows matrices in row-major order. Just bear in
mind that if you are reading the source code, you'll have to take the
transpose of any matrices outlined here to make sense of the calculations.

methods.name: fill
methods.documentation: 把repeat=(1,1)、offset=(0,0)，返回同纹理；不改center/rotation/matrix，也不主动updateMatrix，因此称为“清除所有纹理变换”不准确。
